階.story: Everyone (皆) climbs the **hill** (⻖) step by step, rising one **storey** at a time.

管.story: A busy **bureaucrat** (官) blows through a hollow **bamboo** (竹) **pipe** to call his staff to order.

兵.story: Eight (八) boots tramp over the **hill** (丘) as a squad of **soldiers** marches past.

接.story: A **hand** (扌) reaches out to a palace lady (妾), and their fingertips meet in first **contact**.

細.story: A **thread** (糸) laid across a **rice field** (田) is so **slender** you can barely see it.

効.story: Mingle (交) your **power** (力) with a friend's and the result has a real **effect**.

湾.story: **Water** (氵) curves like a drawn bow (弯) into the coastline, filling a wide **bay**.

録.story: Carving (彔) words into **gold** (金) keeps a lasting **record** that never fades.

省.story: The **ministry** official runs an **eye** (目) over the budget and keeps only a **few** (少) items, leaving out the rest.

旧.story: A tally **line** (丨) beside a **day** (日) on the calendar marks a date long past, from the **old times**.

橋.story: A tall **tree** (木) is felled and laid up **high** (喬) across the gorge to make a **bridge**.

岸.story: Below the **mountain** (山) and its **cliff** (厂) lies a strip of **dry** (干) sand: the **beach**.

周.story: A good-luck (吉) charm sits inside a box (冂), and you walk all the way around its **circumference** for fortune.

材.story: A **genius** (才) carpenter spots a perfect **tree** (木) and saws it into fine **timber**.

戸.story: A short roof line sits over a single hinged panel: a plain wooden **door** standing in its frame.

央.story: A **line** (丨) runs straight down through a **large** (大) figure, splitting him right in the **center**.

券.story: A **knife** (刀) slices neatly along the dotted line to cut off your **ticket**.

冊.story: Two **hands** (廾) tie strips of bamboo into a box-shaped (冂) bundle: one bound **volume**.

編.story: Small (扁), even loops of **thread** (糸) link row after row as Grandma sits down to **knit**.

捜.story: An **old person** (叟) pats the sofa with one **hand** (扌), trying to **search** for lost glasses.

召.story: The chef taps his **knife** (刀) on the pot and opens his **mouth** (口) to **call** everyone to dinner.

超.story: **Run** (走) when they **call** (召) your name and you zoom right past them at **super** speed.

並.story: **Eight** (八) friends stand shoulder to shoulder on **one** (一) chalk line, in a neat **row**.

療.story: A **sickness** (疒) melts away beside a warm, glowing bonfire (尞) as the patient begins to **heal**.

採.story: A **hand** (扌) reaches into the bowl and **picks** out the luckiest **dice** (采).

林.story: Two **trees** (木) standing side by side make a small, shady **grove**.

森.story: Stack one more **tree** (木) on top of a **grove** (林) and you are lost in a deep **forest**.

競.story: Two **elder brothers** (兄) **stand up** (立) side by side at the starting line, ready to **compete**.

介.story: A **person** (人) steps in between two posts (丿 丨) that keep bumping each other, ready to **mediate**.

根.story: A **tree** (木) is **stopped** (艮) from toppling in the storm by its strong, deep **root**.

販.story: **Shells** (貝) slide back and forth (反) across the market counter every time you **sell** something.

歴.story: Under a **cliff** (厂) an old **grove** (林) has grown for centuries; **stop** (止) and count its rings to feel the **passage of time**.

将.story: A **claw** (⺤) slides a wooden piece (⺦) one **inch** (寸) across the battle map as the **commander** plans the attack.

幅.story: **Cloth** (巾) is unrolled from a full bolt (畐) and the tailor measures its **width**.

舟.story: A little wooden **boat** seen from the side: a pointed prow, a dot of a passenger, and two planks for seats.

般.story: A **boat** (舟) loaded with tools and **weapons** (殳) carries cargo for everyone in **general**, not just one person.

貿.story: A **rabbit** (卯) swaps carrots for **shells** (貝) at the market: that is **trade**.

講.story: Words (言) carefully **put together** (冓) into a clear talk make a good **lecture**.

装.story: A **robust** (壮) warrior slips into a shiny **garment** (衣), proud of his new **attire**.

諸.story: **Someone** (者) after someone **says** (言) their piece, and you hear the voices of **various** people.

劇.story: A **wild boar** (豦) charges an actor waving a prop **knife** (刂) on stage. What a **drama**!

河.story: This **water** (氵) is wide, but you **can** (可) still pass it by boat: a great **river**.

航.story: A **boat** (舟) full of sailors in **high spirits** (亢) sets out to **navigate** the open sea.

鉄.story: The **gold** (金) is **lost** (失); all that is left in the old mine is plain **iron**.

児.story: On wobbly little **legs** (儿), a toddler giggles at photos from the **old times** (旧): he is still just a **child**.

禁.story: A sign **shown** (示) at the edge of the **grove** (林) reads: entry **forbidden**.

印.story: A quick **slash** (丿) and **line** (丨) are carved, then a **seal** (卩) is pressed down to leave a red **stamp**.

逆.story: A **disobedient** (屰) kid **walks** (⻌) against the crowd, going the **reverse** way.

換.story: A **hand** (扌) swaps a dull bulb for a **bright** (奐) one: a quick **change**.

久.story: Someone **wrapped** (𠂊) in a heavy cloak trudges on with a long, dragging stride, on the road for a **long time**.

短.story: An **arrow** (矢) no longer than a **bean** (豆) is ridiculously **short**.

油.story: It looks like **water** (氵) but floats on top. **Why** (由)? Because it is **oil**.

暴.story: On a scorching **day** (日), tempers in the crowd boil over into a wild **outburst**.

輪.story: A **car** (車) designer **thinks methodically** (侖) until he draws the perfect round **wheel**.

占.story: She reads the cracks of **divination** (卜) and speaks your future with her **mouth** (口): that is **fortune-telling**.

植.story: Stand the young **tree** (木) **straight** (直) up in the hole and firmly **plant** it.

清.story: **Water** (氵) so **blue** (青) you can see every pebble on the bottom is perfectly **pure**.

倍.story: A **person** (亻) **spits out** (咅) watermelon seeds twice as fast as his friend: **double** the speed!

均.story: Rake the **soil** (土) into **equal** (匀) piles until the whole field is perfectly **level**.

億.story: One **person** (亻) with a brilliant **idea** (意) could earn a **hundred million** yen.

圧.story: A **cliff** (厂) of rock bears down on the **soil** (土) beneath, squeezing it with huge **pressure**.

芸.story: Out on the **grass** (艹), a street performer **says** (云) his lines and juggles with real **art**.

署.story: **Someone** (者) caught in the police **net** (罒) is taken to the station to add a **signature** to the report.

伸.story: A **person** (亻) who **has the honor to** (申) meet the queen **stretches** up as tall as possible.

停.story: A tired **person** (亻) spots a roadside **pavilion** (亭) and comes to a **halt** for a rest.

爆.story: **Fire** (火) meets a wild **outburst** (暴) and BOOM, the **bomb** bursts open.

陸.story: **Hills** (⻖) and clods of **earth** (坴) stretch as far as the sailors can see: solid **land** at last.

玉.story: The **king** (王) keeps one tiny **dot** (丶) close at his side: his precious **jewel**.

波.story: **Water** (氵) ripples like an animal's **pelt** (皮) in the wind, rolling into **waves**.

帯.story: **Thirty** (丗) ribbons sewn under a **cover** (冖) of **cloth** (巾) wind together into one long **sash**.

延.story: Take one more **correct** (正) **long stride** (廴) and you **prolong** the walk a little further.

羽.story: Two matching wings sit side by side, each ruffled with a pair of short strokes like soft **feathers**.

則.story: With a **knife** (刂), the elders carve into a big **shell** (貝) tablet and set down every **rule**.

乱.story: A **tongue** (舌) wagging every **second** (乙) of class stirs the whole room into **disorder**.

普.story: Every **day** (日) people stand in the same **row** (並) for the morning train: a **universal** habit.

測.story: Dip a measuring **rule** (則) into the **water** (氵) to **measure** how deep it is.

豊.story: **Bean** (豆) vines **bend** (曲) under the weight of so many pods: a **bountiful** harvest.

厚.story: Under a **cliff** (厂) on a freezing **day** (日), a **child** (子) is bundled in **thick** layers of coats.

齢.story: 'Count the **teeth** (歯),' the vet **orders** (令), 'and you can guess the horse's **age**.'

囲.story: A **well** (井) sits inside an **enclosure** (囗): a fence built to **surround** it.

卒.story: After **ten** (十) years of study, **two people** (从) toss their caps like **lids** (亠) into the air as they **graduate**.

略.story: Instead of walking to **each** (各) **rice field** (田), the farmer sketches a quick map: an **abbreviation** of the land.

了.story: A single **hook** (亅) hangs under a flat bar: the work is **complete**, so hang up your tools.

承.story: **Three** (三) streams of **water** (水) pour in until the pond is **complete** (了), and it calmly **acquiesces**, taking them all.

順.story: Swimmers' **heads** (頁) bob down the **stream** (川) one after another, in perfect **order**.

岩.story: A **stone** (石) as big as a **mountain** (山) is one massive **rock**.

練.story: Each dawn, facing the sunrise in the **east** (東), she spins **thread** (糸) over and over to **practice**.

軽.story: A **car** (車) blessed as **holy** (圣) seems to float down the road, rolling along **lightly**.

庁.story: The big **house on the cliff** (广) at the end of the **street** (丁) is the town's **government office**.

城.story: Piles of **soil** (土) slowly **turn into** (成) high walls and towers: a mighty **castle**.

患.story: It feels like a **skewer** (串) poking at your **heart** (心) when you are **afflicted** with an illness.

層.story: Fossil bones (尸) of creatures that **formerly** (曽) lived rest in the cliff, one **layer** on top of another.

片.story: Half of a split log stands alone, a single plank with one flat face showing: **one-sided**.

版.story: A **one-sided** (片) wooden block is carved in reverse (反) so it prints the right way: a **printing block**.

角.story: A curled tip (𠂊) tops a boxy frame, like a horn poking out at a sharp **angle** from the corner.

絡.story: **Thread** (糸) runs from **each** (各) dancer to the next until they are all **entwined**.

損.story: A new **employee** (員) lets the boss's vase slip from his **hand** (扌). Crash! What a **loss**.

募.story: 'You **must not** (莫) give up!' With all their **power** (力), the volunteers **recruit** more helpers.
